reason: Deleting q-contents-limit (task Phase A1) breaks two assertions in this test: a 1:1 question-per-component length check and a contents-options check. packages/engine/src/** is off-limits to this task, so the fix is filed as docs/contracts/requests/mobile-rework.md with the exact replacement code instead of applied.

The ViroReact AR path has never run on a device. The only connected Android device is unauthorised for debugging, no emulator image is installed, and the only JDK present (Android Studio JBR 25) is newer than the Android Gradle Plugin accepts, so `expo prebuild` + `expo run:android` could not be attempted. The store, the plane geometry and the projection are covered by 36 node tests; the session host, the screenshot capture and the plane anchors are not. The Expo Go path is unaffected: `useWorldPose` falls back to the sensors within a second whenever the AR session is not producing transforms.
